snippet.title: Giant's Chalice Trailer (v2 patch)
snippet.description:
GIANT'S CHALICE
avknights.itch.io/giants-chalice

A janky 3D fantasy world inspired by PS1-era adventure games

8 low-poly, flat-colored levels to explore

Off-kilter MIDI soundtrack and equipment that jams with it

Attribute your stats to suit your play style and even the odds

Unforgiving death opportunities for comedy & frustration

Chill with me in the weird world for 3-4 hours
